name: TEMPLATE — Border Piece UI System
description: UI elements inset into ornate SVG border pieces — NOT full-length panels. Borders are corner mortar pieces clinging to edges with Tolkien objects inset. Landscape is visible between border fragments. Think aged stone/metal brackets at corners and edges, not a continuous frame.

components.label: Border — Top Left Corner
components.notes: Corner mortar piece — aged stone/metal bracket. Houses Phase Jewel + Adventure HUD. Organic shape, NOT a rectangle — edges crumble/taper where they meet landscape. SVG path defines the silhouette.

components.label: Border — Top Center
components.notes: Floating border piece at top center — not connected to corners. Houses Twilight Pool (Mirror of Galadriel). Isolated bracket with ornate edges.

components.label: Border — Top Right Corner
components.notes: Corner mortar piece — upper right. Houses Opp Hand Count. Smaller bracket, tapers along edges.

components.label: Border — Bottom Left Corner
components.notes: Corner mortar piece — lower left. Houses Palantír. L-shaped bracket wrapping the corner, with circular inset for the seeing stone.

components.label: Border — Bottom Center
components.notes: Floating border piece at bottom center. Houses Horn of Gondor (Pass/Done button). Isolated bracket.

components.label: Border — Bottom Right
components.notes: Border piece lower right — before hand fan area. Houses Red Book (Draw Deck). Smaller bracket.

components.label: Border — Left Accent
components.notes: Narrow mortar strip along left edge — NOT full height. Houses Narsil Shards decoration. Crumbling edges, vine/root tendrils, aged stone. Landscape visible above and below this piece.

components.label: Phase Jewel
components.notes: 7 colored jewels in circle + morphing center symbol (shield/eye/chess/bow/swords/sword/star). Fellowship=Gold, Shadow=Violet, Maneuver=Teal, Archery=Green, Assignment=Amber, Skirmish=Red, Regroup=Silver. Active pulses, completed leave dim trail, inactive dim. Hover: popover listing all 7 phases with explanations.

components.label: Adventure HUD
components.notes: Site counter ('3/9') + current site name. Hover: site card preview floats up. Click: opens Middle-earth map overlay — Tolkien's actual hand-drawn cartography as base image(s). Nodes at geographic positions for the 9 adventure deck sites, connected by dotted travel lines. Visited nodes glow/filled, current pulses, future dim. Hover node: shows site card. Zoom/pan for nearby sites. Dynamic path per player's deck (9 from 229 possible sites = unique journey each game). Detailed regional maps may supplement base map for dense areas (Moria, Helm's Deep, Minas Tirith).

components.label: Twilight Pool (Mirror of Galadriel)
components.notes: Twilight token count. Dark rippling water surface in a silver basin — the rules call it a 'pool', so make it literal. Tokens appear as reflections/lights in the water. Surface darkens and churns as twilight count rises.

components.label: Palantír
components.notes: Pile browser + game log hub. Single palantír for the whole board. Idle: swirling mist, faint inner glow. Hover: mist clears, radial options appear — Discard pile (browsable + count), Dead pile (browsable + count), Draw deck count (display), Adventure deck remaining (display), Game log (expandable history). Both FP and Shadow piles accessible (discard/dead are public info) via FP/Shadow toggle. Click option: pile fans out as browsable overlay. Dismiss: cards sweep back into the stone, mist returns. Thematically: 'seeing hidden/distant things' = browsing piles; 'seeing what has transpired' = game log.

components.label: Horn of Gondor (Pass/Done)
components.notes: Pass/Done action button. Blow the horn when your action is complete. Visual: ornate curved horn inset in border. Click: pass priority. Animation: horn briefly glows gold, faint horn-call SFX. Prominent and always accessible during your turn.

components.label: Red Book (Draw Deck)
components.notes: Your draw deck — cards remaining. Unread pages = cards yet to draw. Visual: leather-bound red book, page count decreases as deck thins. The story being written as you play.

components.label: Narsil → Andúril (Border Deco)
components.notes: Non-functional atmospheric decoration along left border. Scattered blade fragments at site 1, progressively reassembling as fellowship advances. Fully reforged Andúril by site 9. Silver-blue Elvish steel glow. Rewards attention without demanding it.

components.label: Opponent Hand Count
components.notes: Small badge in upper-right border showing opponent's hand size (public info). Compact — just a number.

components.label: Barad-dûr (Burden Tracker)
components.notes: Cinematic burden tracker — NOT a border piece, lives ON the board landscape. 6 keyframe PNGs interpolated via CSS transforms. 0 burdens: tiny/faint/distant tower. Max burdens: Eye of Sauron fills the frame. Camera cranes upward as corruption grows. Combined with global corruption CSS filters (chromatic aberration, grain, desaturation, vignette, micro-jitter).

components.label: One Ring (Assignment Wait)
components.notes: Spinning One Ring displayed center-screen during shadow assignment phase (FP player waiting state). Accompanied by cycling Tolkien quotations (30-50 curated book quotes). Builds tension — you know minions are being assigned but not how.

components.label: Fellowship Zone
components.notes: Transparent card-landing area on landscape. Cards presented as standees in heavy bases with culture-colored borders. Ghost-faint dashed boundary visible only when contextually relevant. Contact shadows, ring ripples, culture glow ground cards to landscape.

components.label: Shadow Zone
components.notes: Transparent card-landing area on landscape. Minion standees. Ghost-faint dashed boundary. All minions must sit BELOW the horizon line — grounded on terrain, never floating above landscape.

components.label: Hand Fan
components.notes: Quarter-circle arc from lower-right corner. Cards overlap significantly (top ~30% visible). Arc bottom extends off-screen. Culture-specific thumb holds fan (hobbit/gauntlet/leather/elven/dwarven/orc/uruk/spectral based on deck culture majority). ~25% width × 12-15% height actual card footprint. Hover card: lifts from fan, fully visible. Click to play.
